name: create specter
desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets a Humanoid corpse within [[lookup @range.value activity=ypIQdXr13u7LATUP]] feet of itself that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute. The target's spirit rises as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmSpecter0000000]{Specter} in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have no more than seven specters under its control at a time.
